prompt:

| Return 3m            | +28.8% |
| Return 1m            | -6.3% |
| Return 1w            | -0.7% |
| Range position (63d) | 70% |
| 21d realized vol     | 24% |
| Last close           | 622.79 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:

Given the positive trend and potential for near-term continuation, a modestly constructive stance is warranted for a ~20-day horizon.

DECISION: BUY
